title: Guest shadowbanned after posting photo with Malone at Heretic-con

tellings.quote: Honestly, same when I posted that picture uh with him back in Heredicon, dude, I got shadowbanned instantly.

plain: An unnamed researcher says that after posting a picture of himself with Robert Malone, taken at a conference called Heretic-con, he was "shadowbanned instantly" on X, formerly Twitter, meaning the platform quietly hid his posts from others. He tells Michels this from his own experience. To him it suggests the platform suppresses people seen with certain figures.
